6. Red dots: node 4 at (10, 28), node 17 at (28, 10)

- Top-right: (10, 52) - with black center (node 6 at (10, 52))
- Bottom-left: (52, 10) - with black center (node 26 at (52, 10))
The red dots are at:
- Node 4: (10, 28)
- Node 17: (28, 10)
Interesting! The red dot (node 4) is at row 10, same as the top-right red cross center. The red dot (node 17) is at col 10, same as the bottom-left red cross center.
Maybe the goal is to move the red dots to the red cross positions? But how?
Actually, let me think about this differently. The light green container was at cols 28-31 initially, and the red dot was at (10, 31). After shrinking, the red dot is at (10, 28). The yellow bar was at rows 28-35 initially, and the red dot was at (34, 10). After shrinking, the red dot is at (28, 10).
So the red dots moved from the "far" end of the container to the "near" end as the container shrank. Maybe the "n" shapes can also move the red dots in the opposite direction?
Wait, let me think about the "n" shape orientations:
- Node 13 (left green "n"): opens to the right (NNN / Nccc / NNN)
- Node 14 (right green "n"): opens to the left (NNN / cccN / NNN)
- Node 20 (top yellow "n"): opens downward (YYY / YcY / YcY)
- Node 23 (bottom yellow "n"): opens upward (YcY / YcY / YYY)
So the "n" shapes have a direction. Node 13 opens right, node 14 opens left, node 20 opens down, node 23 opens up.
When I clicked on node 13 (opens right), the light green container shrank from the right side, pushing the red dot to the left. When I clicked on node 20 (opens down), the yellow bar shrank from the bottom, pushing the red dot up.
So the "n" shapes shrink the container in the direction they open, pushing the red dot in the opposite direction.
Now, what if I click on node 14 (opens left)? It would shrink the container from the left side, pushing the red dot to the right. Similarly, clicking on node 23 (opens up) would shrink the yellow bar from the top, pushing the red dot down.
But wait, the containers are already at 5 pixels (minimum size). Can they shrink further? Or can they grow and then shrink in the other direction?
Actually, let me re-examine. The light green container is at 5 pixels, and the red dot is at (10, 28). If I click on node 14 (opens left), it would grow the container (as we saw earlier), pulling the red dot back in. But maybe if I click on node 14 when the container is at 5 pixels, it does something different?
Let me try clicking on node 14 to see what happens.
